Chapter 578: Chapter 20 Peak (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 578: Chapter 20 Peak (Seeking Subscriptions)

After the Lust Church completely “withdrew,” the Rank Church, as usual, inquired about Anpu City and the surrounding viscounties.

This matter was then considered thoroughly resolved.

Lin Yuan’s life returned to peace.

In Longshan City, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the center of the cultivation field.

“Rule of Time… The great scholars of our human civilization, based on the nature of the Rule of Time, have summarized 2,173 Rule of Time models…”

Lin Yuan pondered, compared to nearly ten thousand Spatial Rule models, there are far fewer Time Rule models, but the difficulty of comprehending the latter is much greater than the former.

...

And even if one comprehends all 2,173 Time Rule models, it doesn’t mean one has fully understood the complete Rule of Time.

To completely understand the Rule of Time, one needs to derive the last step on their own.

The 2,173 Time Rule models simply provide a direction for evolvers to comprehend the Rule of Time.

“I have not yet recovered to the Ninth Rank, cannot open Spatial Layers, but I have made considerable progress in understanding the Rule of Time…”

Lin Yuan felt something wonderful inside. Over the century, he had comprehended more than a hundred Time Rule models, nearly achieving ‘minor accomplishment.’

This was a depth of understanding usually possessed only by Tenth Rank Evolvers.

Furthermore, Lin Yuan also had deeper insights about Space Rules.

It is not to say that once the Complete Space Rules are comprehended, there are no more debts in the realm of Space Rules, for Space Rules are vast and endless, presented in different aspects,

what Supreme Beings comprehend about Space Rules is on an entirely different level compared to ordinary Ninth Rank Evolvers.

The Moyu Tower Master’s “Void Interpretation” described the essence of Space Rules from another angle, benefiting Lin Yuan greatly, giving him new insights every time he reviewed it.

“Hm?”

“Is everyone here?”

Lin Yuan glanced around and noticed that many members of the Longshan Family had already gathered at the edge of the cultivation field, watching him fervently.

A trace of invisible and illusory power began to converge towards Lin Yuan.

“This world is indeed suitable for following the path of belief…” Lin Yuan knew that the power converging was the belief from the Longshan Family members in him.

This would be extremely incredible in the Main World Prime Universe.

In the human civilization of the Main World, some Evolvers also tried to follow the path of belief, but found that the power of belief was hard to gather, while it was much easier in this world.

“Unfortunately, the power of belief is too dependent on living beings; if the believers disappear or die, gods who rely on belief as their foundation will also lose their source of power…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Compared to the path of belief, he still preferred to amass power within himself, even if spreading the Evolution Path just made Lin Yuan’s Ultimate Leap a bit easier.

But that’s not to say that without spreading the Evolution Path, Lin Yuan couldn’t step into the Twelfth Rank.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts wandered as he looked at the growing number of Longshan Family members.

In order to better spread the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, Lin Yuan every so often lectured within the Longshan Family on the key essence of Martial Tao Cultivation.

“The leader, that’s our leader.”

“The leader is so powerful, just watching him makes my heart tremble.”

“Of course, our leader, the Longshan family head, is regarded as the number one Fourth Level Knight in several major viscounties, and in the future, he is expected to become a fifth-level grand knight, a super genius…”

The Longshan Family members excitedly discussed, with many not practicing the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, but came specially to see Lin Yuan.

Over the century, Longshan Ling’s development had caught the attention of several neighboring viscounties. These viscounties joined forces, sending over a dozen peak Fourth Level Knights to Longshan City, trying to pressure the newly appointed Baron Longshan.

Those peak Fourth Level Knights were beaten by Lin Yuan single-handedly, without even a chance to fight back.

Since then, the several viscounty territories no longer dared to consider any designs against Longshan Ling. In their view, the strength of Baron Longshan was already nearly close to a fifth-level grand knight, and entering that rank was just a matter of time.

What the peak Fourth Level Knights from these viscounties did not know was that the Baron Longshan they faced was on par with a True God, a terrifying existence.

Time passed.

Quickly, two hours went by.

Lin Yuan’s lecture was coming to an end, and the surrounding Longshan Family members listened as if spellbound.

Given Lin Yuan’s understanding of the essence of power, even if he wasn’t skilled at teaching disciples, his description and explanation of Martial Tao Cultivation directly pointed to the core.

The Longshan Family members, if not understanding immediately, at least had some insights, and could gain more by thinking and reviewing after returning home.

Above Longshan City.

A slightly distorted space.

Several figures were standing there, intently watching Lin Yuan below, who was giving his lecture.

The three figures at the forefront, with subdued auras, were all Sixth Level legendary knights, the empire’s ultimate reserve strength.

On the Plateau of Myriad Nations, perhaps the most powerful empires have demi-gods of Seventh Level, but most do not; Sixth Level is already the limit.

Seventh Level demi-gods generally have two choices, one is to serve a True God, and the other is to secretly spread beliefs, attempting to become a god themselves.

“Lord Fabian, the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill is spread by that Baron Longshan,” said a blond young man respectfully to the elderly man standing at the forefront.

Fabian, a myth of the empire, a peak Sixth Level legendary knight, even likely to ignite divine fire and step into the realm of the Seventh Level demi-god.
